ExtraBar 1.2.4 – Move It, Make It Yours! 🚀📦

✨ What's New

  • Action Move & Copy: Move or copy any action or folder anywhere in the app! Multi-select support, maximum flexibility – reorganize your setup exactly how you want!
  • Per-Preset Menu Mode: Menu Mode is now a per-preset setting instead of global! Enable or disable it for each preset in Settings, toggle instantly with Option+Shift+Cmd+M (customizable), or use the new toggle in the ExtraBar context menu!
  • Menu Mode Persistence: Presets now remember their Menu Mode settings – enabled state and icon are saved per preset for a seamless experience!

🔖 Shiori Bookmarks Improvements

  • Enhanced Bookmark Experience: UI and UX refinements for a smoother, more polished bookmark workflow!
  • New Lifetime Plan: Introducing a fixed-price lifetime plan for ExtraBar users – no limits, one price, forever!

🧹 Cleanup

  • Removed "Import from Preset": The new move/copy workflow now covers this use case – cleaner UI, less redundancy!

🚀 What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraBar more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraBar community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make – keep it coming! 💙
